folder.title: Select your AAOS Logging vehicle
folder.description: Enter the Google Drive URL or ID of AAOSLogging/<car-name>_<vehicle-id>. Select the car folder, which contains Sync and Backup. Synchronize your car using AAOS Logging V3 first. All access is read-only; logged values are completed-trip snapshots.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect read-only Google Drive access
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again to restore read-only access to the same AAOS Logging vehicle folder.

error.invalid_auth: Google did not grant access. Reconnect using dedicated read-only credentials.
error.invalid_export: This folder does not contain a complete supported AAOS Logging V3 snapshot. Select the vehicle folder and complete a car-side sync; check Home Assistant logs for import errors.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to read Google Drive. Check your connection, permissions and Drive API configuration.

abort.already_configured: This vehicle dataset is already configured.
abort.readonly_required: A read-only Drive grant is required. Use a dedicated Google OAuth client with only drive.readonly, without a previous write-access grant.
abort.refresh_token_required: Google did not return a refresh token. Revoke this dedicated application's consent and sign in again.
abort.wrong_dataset: This account or folder contains a different vehicle dataset.
abort.cannot_read_folder: The existing vehicle folder could not be read. Check the account and complete an AAOS Logging sync.
abort.reauth_successful: Read-only Google Drive access has been restored.

application_credentials.description: Enable Google Drive API and create a dedicated Web application OAuth client. Declare only https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.readonly. Add {redirect_url} as an authorized redirect URI. Configure consent at {oauth_consent_url} and credentials at {oauth_creds_url}. See {more_info_url}.
